target.title: fix(codex): project guardianWarning circuit-breaker notification
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the codex app-server event projector **silently dropped** the `guardianWarning` notification. Codex emits this notification when its guardian review hits its rejection circuit-breaker (3 consecutive or 10 total denials in a turn), right before ending the turn as `interrupted`. OpenClaw projected `item/autoApprovalReview/*` and `turn/completed` but had no case for `guardianWarning`, so the rejection-limit reason vanished and the turn degraded to a generic interruption with no indication of why.

Closes #101207

## Why This Change Was Made

- Added a `guardianWarning` case to the projector's notification switch and a `handleGuardianWarning` helper that emits an agent event on the `codex_app_server.guardian` stream with `phase: "warning"` and the warning `message`, alongside the existing `autoApprovalReview` handling.
- Because `guardianWarning` is **thread-scoped** — codex emits it with only `{ message, threadId }` and no `turnId` — it is correlated on the thread alone (mirroring how `hook/*` notifications bypass the turn-strict check). Without this routing, the turn-strict pre-switch filter would drop every `guardianWarning` before it ever reached the switch, making the handler dead code for real traffic.

A potential follow-up (not in this PR) is surfacing the warning in user-visible attempt metadata; that needs a UX-placement decision, so this PR ships the projection parity first.

## User Impact

Consumers observing codex turns (telemetry/audit/agent-event streams) now see the guardian circuit-breaker warning instead of a bare interruption, making it clear the turn was ended because guardian rejections hit the limit — not because of a tool failure or crash.

## Evidence

Regression test in `extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` sends a real `{ threadId, message }` `guardianWarning` payload (no synthetic `turnId`) and asserts the warning agent event is projected on the `codex_app_server.guardian` stream. Without the thread-scoped routing the notification is dropped and the test fails. Codex app-server shard is green (126 tests).
